t: What is the unit digit of 5<sup>5</sup> + 6<sup>9</sup> + 7<sup>13</sup> + 8<sup>17 </sup>+ ... + 15<sup>45</sup>?
e: The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number. Cyclicity chart: Number | Cyclicity | Unit digit values Power 1 | Power 2 | Power 3 | Power 4 0 | 1 | 0 | | | 1 | 1 | 1 | | | 2 | 4 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 6 3 | 4 | 3 | 9 | 7 | 1 4 | 2 | 4 | 6 | | 5 | 1 | 5 | | | 6 | 1 | 6 | | | 7 | 4 | 7 | 9 | 3 | 1 8 | 4 | 8 | 4 | 2 | 6 9 | 2 | 9 | 1 | | (Note: when remainder is 0, power = cyclicity) In the given series 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545, we can see that power of every next term is increased by 4 than power of previous number and from cyclicity table, we can see the cyclicity of numbers from 0 to 9. Now, from cyclicity, we know unit digit of 5th power of 5 will be 5, 9th power of 6 will be 6 and so on. Then, unit digit of 55 + 69 + 713 + 817 + ... + 1545 = unit digit of (5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + .. + 15) In the above series, First term = 5 = a Last term = 15 = an Common difference = d = 6 - 5 = 1 Then, an = a + (n - 1)d 15 = 5 + (n - 1) x 1 n = 11 Then, unit digit of (5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + .. + 15) = unit digit of (n/2)(a + an) = unit digit of (11/2)(5 + 15) = unit digit of 110 = 0
h: 5<sup>5</sup> + 6<sup>9</sup> + 7<sup>13</sup> + 8<sup>17 </sup>+ ... + 15<sup>45</sup> का इकाई अंक क्या है?

t: All odd prime numbers upto 110 are multiplied together. What is the unit digit in this product?
e:
Odd primes up to 110 include 5 (units digit 5), and every other factor is odd (there is no factor of 2 anywhere, since all primes here besides 2 are odd, and 2 itself is excluded as we only want odd primes).
Units-digit rule: a number ending in 5, multiplied only by odd numbers, always keeps a units digit of 5 (you only get a trailing 0 if a factor of 2 is also present).
So the product's units digit stays 5 → only option (c) matches; option (d) "None of the above" is therefore also ruled out.

The list of odd primes up to 110 includes 5, 3, 7, 11, 13, ... 109 — all are odd (no factor of 2 present anywhere).
Since 5 is one of the factors and every other factor is odd, the product always ends in 5
(5 × odd number always ends in 5, never 0, because there's no even number to pair with the 5).
Unit digit = 5 → option (c).
h: 110 तक की सभी विषम अभाज्य संख्याओं को एक साथ गुणा किया जाता है। इस गुणनफल में इकाई का अंक क्या है?

t: 5 men and 3 women can earn ₹8,400 in 4 days. 9 men and 7 women can earn ₹28,700 in 7 days. In how many days will 8 men and 5 women earn ₹30,600?
e:
Convert both to one-day earnings: 8400/4 = 2100/day (5m+3w); 28700/7 = 4100/day (9m+7w). Subtract cleverly: multiply first eq by 7 and second by 3, then subtract to eliminate w quickly, or just solve the two simple simultaneous equations directly (fastest here since numbers are small): 5m+3w=2100 ... (i); 9m+7w=4100 ... (ii) (i)×7: 35m+21w=14700; (ii)×3: 27m+21w=12300; subtract: 8m=2400 → m=300, then w=200.

From m=300, w=200: one day's earning of 8 men + 5 women = 8(300)+5(200) = 2400+1000 = 3400. Days required = 30600/3400 = 9 days. Setting up per-day-earning equations first (rather than per-4-days or per-7-days) is the key concept that keeps numbers simple.
h: 5 पुरुष और 3 महिलाएँ 4 दिनों में ₹8,400 कमा सकते हैं। 9 पुरुष और 7 महिलाएँ 7 दिनों में ₹28,700 कमा सकते हैं। 8 पुरुष और 5 महिलाएँ कितने दिनों में ₹30,600 कमाएँगे?

t: If x = 110, y = 111, z = 112 then find the value of x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz.
e:
Since x, y, z = 110, 111, 112 are three consecutive numbers, x²+y²+z²−xy−yz−zx = ½[(x−y)²+(y−z)²+(z−x)²] = ½[1+1+4] = 3, and x+y+z = 333.
So the answer = 333 × 3.
Units digit shortcut: units digit of 333 is 3, and 3×3 = 9 → units digit of the answer is 9.
Check options: (a) 999 ends 9 ✓; (b) 991 ends 1; (c) 997 ends 7; (d) 995 ends 5.
Only (a) ends in 9 — confirmed directly from the units digit, no need to multiply 333×3 out.

Using identity: x³+y³+z³-3xyz = (x+y+z)(x²+y²+z²-xy-yz-zx)
x+y+z = 110+111+112 = 333
For consecutive numbers, x²+y²+z²-xy-yz-zx = ½[(x-y)²+(y-z)²+(x-z)²] = ½[1+1+4] = 3
Answer = 333×3 = 999 → option (a).
h: यदि x = 110, y = 111, z = 112 है, तो x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are true?
I. The unit digit of the sum of the first 183 natural numbers is 6.
II. The unit digit of (213)<sup>329</sup> X (189)<sup>282</sup> X (517)<sup>511</sup> is 9.
III. Total number of odd factors of 2520 is 15
o: All of I, II and III
e: I: Sum of first 183 natural numbers = 183(183 + 1)/2 = 183*92 So, unit's digit will be 3*2 = 6 I is true II: Unit digit of (213)329 X (189)282 X (517)511 = unit digit of 3329 X 9282 X 7511 We know the cyclicity of the numbers: Number | Cyclicity 1, 5, 6 | 1 4, 9 | 2 2, 3, 7, 8 | 4 Unit digit of 3329 = Unit digit of 34 X 82 + 1 = Unit digit of 31 = 3 Unit digit of 9282 = 1 Unit digit of 7511 = Unit digit of 74 X 127 + 3 = Unit digit of 73 = 3 So, Unit digit of (215)327 X (189)282 X (517)511 = 3 X 1 X 3 = 9 II is true III. 2520 = 23 X 32 X 5 X 7 Number of odd factors = (2 + 1)(1 + 1)(1 + 1) = 3*2*2 = 12 III is false
h:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है / हैं?
I. पहले 183 प्राकृतिक संख्याओं के योग का इकाई अंक 6 है।
II. (213)<sup>329</sup> X (189)<sup>282</sup> X (517)<sup>511</sup> का इकाई अंक 9 है।
III. 2520 के विषम गुणक की कुल संख्या 15 है

t: A bullet train covers a fixed distance in 30 minutes at an average speed of 240 km/h. Due to track maintenance, it needs to be diverted, increasing the distance by 20%. If the train needs to arrive at its destination on time (i.e., in 30 minutes), what should its new average speed be in km/h?
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) 280 km/h → ends in 0; (b) 300 km/h → ends in 0; (c) 288 km/h → ends in 8; (d) 320 km/h → ends in 0.
The exact value works out to 288 km/h (see Solution 2), ending in 8 — only option (c) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

Original distance = 240×(30/60) = 120 km
New distance (20% more) = 120×1.2 = 144 km
Since time stays the same (30 min = 0.5 hr): New speed = 144/0.5 = 288 km/h → option (c).
(Shortcut: since time is constant, new speed = old speed × 1.2 = 240×1.2 = 288 km/h directly.)
h: एक बुलेट ट्रेन 240 किमी/घंटा की औसत गति से 30 मिनट में एक निश्चित दूरी तय करती है। ट्रैक रखरखाव के कारण, इसे डायवर्ट करने की आवश्यकता है, जिससे दूरी 20% बढ़ जाती है। यदि ट्रेन को समय पर (यानी, 30 मिनट में) अपने गंतव्य पर पहुंचना है, तो इसकी नई औसत गति किमी/घंटा में क्या होनी चाहिए?

t: When 1063, 2815 and 3451 are divided by the largest number x, the remainder in each case is y. Find the value of (3x-14y).
e:
The largest such divisor x = HCF of the pairwise differences: (2815-1063), (3451-2815), (3451-1063) = HCF(1752, 636, 2388). Quick HCF via Euclid: HCF(1752,636)=12, HCF(12,2388)=12. So x = 12. Remainder y = 1063 mod 12 = 7 (since 12×88=1056, 1063-1056=7). 3x-14y = 36-98 = -62.

The rule: if three numbers leave the same remainder when divided by x, then x divides all pairwise differences exactly. Differences: 1752, 636, 2388. HCF(1752,636): 1752=2×636+480; 636=1×480+156; 480=3×156+12; 156=13×12+0 → HCF=12. Confirm 2388/12=199 exactly, so x=12 is consistent. y = 1063 mod 12 = 7. 3(12)-14(7) = 36-98 = -62.
h: जब 1063, 2815 और 3451 को सबसे बड़ी संख्या x से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो प्रत्येक स्थिति में शेषफल y होता है। (3x-14y) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: An electric fan lists at ₹265.80 and is sold at a discount of 10%. The shopkeeper gives a further discount of 8% for cash payment. The selling price of the fan, when payment is made in cash, is:
e:
Both discounts must be applied since the question asks for the price actually paid in cash (after the further discount). Combined retained fraction = 0.90×0.92 = 0.828, so directly multiply 265.80×0.828 in one shot instead of two separate steps — this gives ₹220.08 in a single multiplication. Watch out: option (c) ₹239.22 is a common trap — that's only the price after the FIRST 10% discount, before the cash discount is applied.

After first discount: 265.80×0.90 = 239.22. Applying the further 8% cash discount: 239.22×0.92 = 220.0824 ≈ ₹220.08. This is the final cash selling price, matching option (b).
h: एक इलेक्ट्रिक पंखा 265.80 रुपये पर सूचीबद्ध है और 10% की छूट पर बेचा जाता है। दुकानदार नकद भुगतान पर 8% की अतिरिक्त छूट देता है। जब भुगतान नकद में किया जाता है, तो पंखे का विक्रय मूल्य हैः

t: Alok, Gita, and Suresh invest ₹56,000, ₹52,000, and ₹69,000 respectively to start a business. At the end of the year, the total profit earned is ₹76,700. 31% of the total profit earned is given to charity and the rest is divided among them in the ratio of their investment. What will be the share of Suresh (in ₹)?
e:
The units digit alone repeats across options here, so check the last TWO digits instead:
(a) ₹20,631 → last two digits 31; (b) ₹20,693 → last two digits 93; (c) ₹20,551 → last two digits 51; (d) ₹20,727 → last two digits 27.
The exact value is ₹20,631 (see Solution 2), whose last two digits are 31 — only option (a) matches, confirming it directly.

Amount to charity = 76700 × 31/100 = ₹23,777
Remaining profit = 76700 - 23777 = ₹52,923
Ratio of investment = 56000:52000:69000 = 56:52:69 (sum = 177)
Suresh's share = 52923 × 69/177 = ₹20,631
This matches option (a) exactly by direct computation.
h: आलोक, गीता और सुरेश ने एक व्यवसाय शुरू करने के लिए क्रमशः ₹56,000, ₹52,000 और ₹69,000 का निवेश किया। वर्ष के अंत में अर्जित कुल लाभ ₹76,700 है। अर्जित कुल लाभ का 31% दान में दिया जाता है और शेष को उनके निवेश के अनुपात में उनके बीच विभाजित किया जाता है। सुरेश का हिस्सा (₹ में) कितना होगा?

t: In a team of 75 employees, the average monthly sales per employee is 1.8 lakh. If 30 junior employees average 1.2 lakh each, what is the average monthly sales figure for the senior employees?
e:
Here the options are close, so pair the units digit with the decimal digits:
(a) ₹4.2 lakh → ones digit 4, decimal part .20
(b) ₹2.2 lakh → ones digit 2, decimal part .20
(c) ₹2.8 lakh → ones digit 2, decimal part .80
(d) ₹2.7 lakh → ones digit 2, decimal part .70
The exact value is ₹2.2 lakh (see Solution 2) → ones digit 2, decimal .20 — only option (b) matches this exact pair, confirming it instantly.

Total sales(75 employees) = 75×1.8 = 135 lakh
Junior total (30 employees) = 30×1.2 = 36 lakh
Senior total (45 employees) = 135-36 = 99 lakh
Senior average = 99/45 = ₹2.2 lakh → option (b).
h: 75 कर्मचारियों की एक टीम में, प्रति कर्मचारी औसत मासिक बिक्री 1.8 लाख है। यदि 30 कनिष्ठ कर्मचारी प्रत्येक का औसत 1.2 लाख है, तो वरिष्ठ कर्मचारियों के लिए औसत मासिक बिक्री का आंकड़ा क्या है?

t: A rectangular piece of paper is 44 cm long and 89 cm wide. A cylinder is formed by rolling the paper along its length. Find the curved surface area of the cylinder.
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) 3902 cm² → ends in 2; (b) 3961 cm² → ends in 1; (c) 3931 cm² → ends in 1; (d) 3916 cm² → ends in 6.
The exact value works out to 3916 cm² (see Solution 2), ending in 6 — only option (d) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

When a rectangle is rolled along its length, CSA of the cylinder formed = Area of rectangle = length × width
= 44 × 89 = 3,916 cm² → option (d).
(No π is required here — rolling a flat sheet preserves its area as the curved surface.)
h: एक आयताकार कागज की लंबाई 44 cm और चौड़ाई 89 cm है। कागज को उसकी लंबाई के अनुदिश मोड़ने पर एक बेलन बनता है। बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A circular signboard has a radius of 2 m. If painting costs 60 per m² and 10% of the board is left unpainted, what is the total painting cost?
e:
The units digit alone repeats across options here, so check the last TWO digits instead:
(a) ₹658.2 → last two digits 58; (b) ₹678.6 → last two digits 78; (c) ₹630.4 → last two digits 30; (d) ₹681.9 → last two digits 81.
The exact value is ₹678.6 (see Solution 2), whose last two digits are 78 — only option (b) matches, confirming it directly.

Area of circle = πr² = π×2² = 4π m²
Painted area = 90% of 4π = 3.6π m²
Cost = 3.6π × 60 = 216π ≈ 216×3.14159 = ₹678.6 → option (b).
(Using π=3.1416 gives the cleanest match to option (b); using 22/7 gives ≈678.86, very close.)
h: एक वृत्ताकार साइनबोर्ड की त्रिज्या 2 मीटर है। यदि पेंटिंग की लागत ₹60 प्रति वर्ग मीटर है और बोर्ड का 10% भाग बिना पेंट किए छोड़ दिया जाता है, तो पेंटिंग की कुल लागत क्या है?

t: Which digit will be in the ones place in the product of 61 × 62 × 63………× 69?
e:
Numbers 61 to 69 include 65 (units digit 5) and several even numbers (62, 64, 66, 68).
Units-digit rule: a number ending in 5, multiplied by any even number, always ends in 0.
Since both a "5" and an even units digit are present among the factors, the product's units digit is locked at 0 → only option (b) matches.

Numbers from 61 to 69 include 65 (unit digit 5) and even numbers like 62, 64, 66, 68 (unit digit even).
5 × (any even digit) always ends in 0. Since both a "5" and an even number are present in the product,
the final unit digit must be 0 → option (b).
h: 61 × 62 × 63 ...... × 69 के गुणनफल में इकाई के स्थान पर कौन सा अंक होगा?

t: The average of 13 numbers is 70. The average of the first five numbers is 60. The average of the next five numbers is 25% higher than the average of the first five numbers. The 11th number is 6 less than the 13th number, and the 12th number is 4 greater than the 13th number. What is the average of the 11th and 12th numbers?
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) 78 → ends in 8; (b) 77 → ends in 7; (c) 76 → ends in 6; (d) 74 → ends in 4.
The exact value works out to 78 (see Solution 2), ending in 8 — only option (a) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

Total sum = 13×70 = 910; first5 sum=5×60=300; next5 avg=60×1.25=75, sum=375
Sum(11th+12th+13th) = 910-300-375 = 235
Let 13th=t: 11th=t-6, 12th=t+4 → (t-6)+t+(t+4)=235 → 3t-2=235 → t=79
11th=73, 12th=83 → average = (73+83)/2 = 78 → option (a).
h: 13 संख्याओं का औसत 70 है। पहली पाँच संख्याओं का औसत 60 है। अगली पाँच संख्याओं का औसत पहली पाँच संख्याओं के औसत से 25% अधिक है। 11वीं संख्या 13वीं संख्या से 6 कम है, और 12वीं संख्या 13वीं संख्या से 4 अधिक है। 11वीं और 12वीं संख्याओं का औसत क्या है?

t: Five solid cubes, each of volume 1,09,41,048 cm³, are joined end to end to form a cuboid. What is the lateral surface area (in cm²) of the cuboid?
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) 5,91,408 → ends in 8; (b) 5,91,310 → ends in 0; (c) 5,91,663 → ends in 3; (d) 5,91,312 → ends in 2.
The exact value works out to 5,91,408 (see Solution 2), ending in 8 — only option (a) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

Side of cube, a = ∛(10941048) = 222 cm
Cuboid formed: length l = 5a = 1110 cm, breadth b = 222 cm, height h = 222 cm
Lateral Surface Area = 2h(l+b) = 2×222×(1110+222) = 2×222×1332 = 5,91,408 cm² → option (a).
h: पांच ठोस घन, जिनमें से प्रत्येक का आयतन 1,09,41,048 सेमी³ है, के सिरों को जोड़कर एक घनाभ बनाया गया है। घनाभ का पार्श्व पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (सेमी² में) ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A logistics company charges ₹15 per km for the first 80 km and ₹12.5 per km thereafter. A consignment was transported for a total of 132.5 km and the total cost was split in the ratio 2 : 3 between the sender and receiver. What amount did the receiver pay?
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) ₹1200 → ends in 0; (b) ₹1350 → ends in 0; (c) ₹1444.2 → ends in 4; (d) ₹1113.75 → ends in 3.
The exact value works out to ₹1113.75 (see Solution 2), ending in 3 — only option (d) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

Cost for first 80 km = 80×15 = ₹1200
Remaining distance = 132.5-80 = 52.5 km → cost = 52.5×12.5 = ₹656.25
Total cost = 1200+656.25 = ₹1856.25
Receiver's share (3 parts of 5) = 1856.25 × 3/5 = ₹1113.75 → option (d).
h: एक लॉजिस्टिक्स कंपनी पहले 80 किमी के लिए ₹15 प्रति किमी और उसके बाद ₹12.5 प्रति किमी का शुल्क लेती है। एक खेप को कुल 132.5 किमी तक ले जाया गया और कुल लागत को प्रेषक और प्राप्तकर्ता के बीच 2 : 3 के अनुपात में विभाजित किया गया। प्राप्तकर्ता ने कितनी राशि का भुगतान किया?

t: A = (x⁸-1)/(x⁴+1) and B = (y⁴-1)/(y²+1). If x = 2 and y = 9, then what is the value of A² + 2AB + AB²?
e:
Simplify A and B first using difference-of-squares factoring: A = (x⁸-1)/(x⁴+1) = (x⁴-1)(x⁴+1)/(x⁴+1) = x⁴-1 = 2⁴-1 = 15 B = (y⁴-1)/(y²+1) = (y²-1)(y²+1)/(y²+1) = y²-1 = 9²-1 = 80 Now factor the target expression: A²+2AB+AB² = A(A+2B+B²) = 15(15+160+6400) = 15×6575 = 98625.

Same simplification of A=15, B=80 using the identity a²-1=(a-1)(a+1) applied twice. Then expand directly: A² = 225, 2AB = 2(15)(80) = 2400, AB² = 15(6400) = 96000. Sum = 225+2400+96000 = 98625. Factoring (Solution 1) is quicker, but direct substitution here confirms the same value.
h: A = (x⁸-1)/(x⁴+1) और B = (y⁴-1)/(y²+1) है। यदि x = 2 और y = 9 है, तो A² + 2AB + AB² का मान क्या है?

t: A person travels a distance of 1980 km, 1306 km and 540 km at the speed of 12 km/hr, x km/hr and 36 km/hr respectively. If his average speed for the whole journey is 14 km/hr, find the value of x.
h: एक व्यक्ति 1980 km, 1306 km और 540 km की दूरी क्रमशः 12 km/hr, x km/hr और 36 km/hr की चाल से तय करता है। यदि पूरी यात्रा के लिए उसकी औसत चाल 14 km/hr है, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The amount on a sum of ₹6,800 at 15% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years' time, will be:
e:
The last digit(s) alone repeat across two options here, so combine the units-digit check with a quick magnitude check:
(a) ₹8,993 → ends in 3; (b) ₹29,393 → ends in 3; (c) ₹8,641 → ends in 1; (d) ₹7,996 → ends in 6.
The exact value is ₹8,993 (see Solution 2). Its units digit (3) matches more than one option, but the size of the number (and the full computation in Solution 2) confirms only option (a) is correct — the units-digit check is used here as a first filter, not the final word.

Amount = 6800 × (1.15)² = 6800 × 1.3225 = ₹8,993 → option (a).
h: ₹6,800 की राशि पर 15% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की दर से, जो वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है, 2 वर्ष के समय में प्राप्त होने वाली मिश्रधन क्या होगी?

t: If x = 99, then find x⁸ - 100x⁷ + 100x⁶ - 100x⁵ + 100x⁴ - 100x³ + 100x² - 100x + 100 is ____
e:
Since x = 99, note 100 = x + 1. Replace every 100 with (x+1) except the last constant term: x⁸-(x+1)x⁷+(x+1)x⁶-(x+1)x⁵+(x+1)x⁴-(x+1)x³+(x+1)x²-(x+1)x + 100 All the x⁸, x⁷...x terms telescope/cancel in pairs, leaving: -x + 100 = -99 + 100 = 1.

Group terms as: (x⁸-100x⁷)+(100x⁶-100x⁵)+(100x⁴-100x³)+(100x²-100x)+100 = x⁷(x-100)+100x⁵(x-1)+100x³(x-1)+100x(x-1)+100 With x = 99, (x-100) = -1 and (x-1) = 98. Substituting and simplifying step by step (a longer route) also converges to 1. The telescoping trick (Solution 1) is far faster here.

Remaining after 5% reinvestment = 7540×0.95 = ₹7,163

t: A survey of 140 students revealed that 60 students like playing video games, 70 students like playing indoor games, and 75 students like playing outdoor games. Only Outdoor = O - (I∩O) - (V∩O) + (V∩I∩O)
= 75 - 30 - 18 + 8 = 35 → option (c).
(Formula: subtract both pairwise overlaps involving Outdoor, then add back the triple-overlap since it was subtracted twice.)
h: 140 विद्यार्थियों के सर्वेक्षण में पाया गया कि 60 विद्यार्थी वीडियो गेम खेलना पसंद करते हैं, 70 विद्यार्थी इनडोर गेम खेलना पसंद करते हैं, तथा 75 विद्यार्थी आउटडोर गेम खेलना पसंद करते हैं। इसके अतिरिक्त 30 छात्र इनडोर और आउटडोर दोनों खेल पसंद करते हैं, 18 को वीडियो गेम और आउटडोर गेम दोनों खेल पसंद हैं, 42 को वीडियो गेम और इनडोर गेम दोनों खेल पसंद हैं, तथा 8 को सभी प्रकार के खेल पसंद हैं। वेन आरेख का उपयोग करके उन छात्रों को ज्ञात कीजिए जो केवल आउटडोर खेल खेलते हैं।

h: एक व्यक्ति 15% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर ₹28,400 उधार लेता है, जिस पर ब्याज वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। प्रत्येक वर्ष के अंत में, वह आंशिक भुगतान के रूप में ₹9,100 चुकाता है। ऐसी दो किश्तों के बाद भी उस पर शेष बकाया कितना है?

t: Solve (111 × 5⁴) = ?

t: Which of the following is the perfect square?

t: Kavita buys 2 apples and 5 mangoes for ₹239. When the cost of an apple is decreased by 50% and that of a mango remains the same, then the cost of 2 apples and 4 mangoes is ₹184. What is the original cost of 8 apples and 8 mangoes?
e:
2apple+5mango=239 ...(i) 2(0.5×apple)+4mango=184 → apple+4mango=184 ...(ii) From (ii): apple=184-4mango. Sub into (i): 2(184-4mango)+5mango=239 368-8mango+5mango=239 → -3mango=-129 → mango=43. apple=184-172=12. 8(12)+8(43) = 96+344 = 440.

50% decrease means new apple price = 0.5×apple, so the second equation simplifies neatly to "apple+4mango=184" — spotting this simplification early makes elimination very fast. Solving gives apple=12, mango=43 (verify: 2(12)+5(43)=24+215=239 ✓). 8(12)+8(43)=₹440.
h: कविता ने 2 सेब और 5 आम ₹239 में खरीदे। जब एक सेब की कीमत 50% कम हो जाती है और एक आम की कीमत वही रहती है, तो 2 सेब और 4 आमों की कीमत ₹184 हो जाती है। 8 सेब और 8 आमों की मूल कीमत क्या है?

t: The price of 4 pens and 5 notebooks is Rs. 130. If the price of a pen increases by 25% and the price of a notebook decreases by 20%, then the price of 2 pens and 4 notebooks becomes Rs. 82. What is the original price of 1 pen and 2 notebooks?

Set up both equations directly (25% increase means ×1.25; 20% decrease means ×0.80), solve simultaneously: pen=20, notebook=10 (verify: 4(20)+5(10)=130 ✓; 2(25)+4(8)=50+32=82 ✓). 1 pen + 2 notebooks = 20+20 = ₹40.

t: In an election between two candidates, 64% of the voters cast their votes, out of which 4% of the votes were declared invalid. A candidate got 12,288 votes which were 64% of the total valid votes. Find the total number of votes enrolled in that election.

t: How many zeroes are there in the product of 10! X 9! X 8! X 7! X 6!?
e:
Since every pair of 2 and 5 gives a zero and in consecutive numbers, multiple of 5 occurs less than multiple of 2, so we need to count only fives.
To find the number of fives in 10*9*8*....*1 we will divide the maximum number (i.e. 10) by 5 and count only quotient i.e. 2.
So, total number of fives in 10! X 9! X 8! X 7! X 6! = (10/5) + (9/5) + (8/5) + (7/5) + (6/5)
= 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1
= 6
Hence, there are six zeroes in 10! X 9! X 8! X 7! X 6!.

t: If the positions of the digits of a two digit number are interchanged, the number obtained is smaller than the original number by 27. If the digits of the number are in the ratio of 2 : 1 then what is the original number?
e: Let the original number be = 10a + b According to the question; 10a + b = 10b + a + 27 => 9a = 9b + 27 => a = b + 3... (1) According to the question; a/b=2/1 => a = 2b... h: यदि दो अंकों की एक संख्या के अंकों के स्थान को परस्पर बदल दिया जाए, तो प्राप्त संख्या मूल संख्या से 27 कम होगी। यदि संख्या के अंक 2 : 1 के अनुपात में हों, तो मूल संख्या क्या है?

t: A and B invested money in a business in the ratio of 8:5. If 35% of the total profit goes for charity, and A's share in the profit is Rs. 7,770, what is the total profit?
e:
Remaining profit after charity = 65% of total (T). This 65%T is split 8:5, so A's share = 65%T × 8/13 = 7770. Simplify 8/13 of 65% = 40%. So 0.40T = 7770 → T = 7770/0.4 = 19425.

Let total profit = T. Charity = 0.35T, remaining = 0.65T. A's share = 0.65T × (8/13) = 7770 0.65 × 8/13 = 5.2/13 = 0.4, so 0.4T = 7770 → T = 19425. Recognising that 8/13 of 65% reduces to a clean 40% is what makes Method 1 a one-line shortcut.
h: A और B ने एक व्यवसाय में 8:5 के अनुपात में धन निवेश किया। यदि कुल लाभ का 35% दान में दिया जाता है, और लाभ में A का हिस्सा 7,770 रुपये है, तो कुल लाभ क्या है?

h: किसी आदमी को प्रत्येक महीने ₹4,190 वेतन मिलता है। वह प्रत्येक महीने अपने वेतन का 70% बचाता है। उसका मासिक व्यय ज्ञात कीजिए।

h: एक रेसिपी में 5 सर्विंग के लिए 0.625 लीटर दूध की आवश्यकता होती है। 3.75 लीटर दूध से कितनी सर्विंग बनाई जा सकती हैं?

t: Simplify the following expression: 81.7100 + 198.0020 – 2071.1985 + 9.0900 + 1591.42
e:

t: A savings scheme offers compound interest annually. A woman deposits ₹10,000. At the end of the first year, the interest rate is 10%. In the second year, due to inflation, the interest rate rises to 12.5%, and in the third year, it drops to 8%. Calculate the total interest she earned at the end of 3 years.
e:
Combined growth factor = 1.10 × 1.125 × 1.08 = 1.3365. Amount = 10000 × 1.3365 = 13,365. CI = 13365-10000 = ₹3,365.

After year 1: 10000×1.10 = 11,000. After year 2 (12.5%): 11000×1.125 = 12,375. After year 3 (8%): 12375×1.08 = 13,365. CI = 13365-10000 = ₹3,365. Multiplying the three growth factors together (Method 1) gives the same result faster than three separate year-by-year steps.
h: एक बचत योजना वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज देती है। एक महिला ₹10,000 जमा करती है। पहले वर्ष के अंत में ब्याज दर 10% है। दूसरे वर्ष, मुद्रास्फीति के कारण, ब्याज दर बढ़कर 12.5% हो जाती है, और तीसरे वर्ष यह घटकर 8% हो जाती है। 3 वर्षों के अंत में उसे कुल कितना ब्याज मिला, इसकी गणना कीजिए।

t: When digits of a two-digit number are reversed and added to the number, then the resultant is 143. If the difference between the digits is 1, then find product of the digits.
e: Let the two-digit number = 10a + b, where a and b are tens and unit digits. When digits of the number are interchanged, then new number = 10b + a Now, 10a + b + 10b + a = 143 11a + 11b = 143 a + b = 13 Difference between digits = (a - b) or (b - a) = 1 a = (13 - 1)/2 = 6, b = 13 - 6 = 7 or b = (13 - 1)/2 = 6, a = 13 - 6 = 7 So, the number can be 67 or 76. Product of digits = 6 * 7 = 42
h: जब दो अंकों वाली संख्या के अंकों को उलट दिया जाता है और संख्या में जोड़ा जाता है, तो परिणाम 143 होता है। यदि अंकों के बीच का अंतर 1 है, तो अंकों का गुणनफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Govind bought two items at a total cost of Rs. 4800. He sold one item at 34% profit and the other at 10% loss. If Govind sold both the items together for Rs.5442, what is the difference between the cost price (in Rs.) of both the items?
e:
Let CP of profit-item = p. Then loss-item CP = 4800-p. 1.34p + 0.90(4800-p) = 5442 1.34p + 4320 - 0.90p = 5442 0.44p = 1122 → p = 2550. Other CP = 4800-2550 = 2250. Difference = 2550-2250 = ₹300.

Setting up the equation: total actual SP = SP(profit item)+SP(loss item) = 5442. 1.34p + 0.9(4800-p) = 5442 → 0.44p = 5442-4320 = 1122 → p = 2550. CPs are 2550 and 2250; difference = ₹300.
h: गोविंद ने दो वस्तुएँ कुल 4800 रुपये की लागत पर खरीदीं। उसने एक वस्तु को 34% लाभ पर और दूसरी को 10% हानि पर बेचा। यदि गोविंद ने दोनों वस्तुओं को मिलाकर 5442 रुपये में बेचा, तो दोनों वस्तुओं के लागत मूल्य का अंतर (रुपये में) क्या है?

t: The rate of simple interest for first two years is 8% p.a., for the next 4 years, it is 10% p.a. and for the period beyond 6 years, it is 12% p.a. If a person gets Rs 18358.60 as simple interest after 9 years, then how much money (in Rs) did he invest?
e:
Total effective rate over 9 years = (8×2)+(10×4)+(12×3) = 16+40+36 = 92%. Principal = SI × 100/92 = 18358.60 × 100/92 = ₹19,955.

SI = P × 92/100 (since total % accumulated over 9 years = 92%, as shown above). 18358.60 = P × 0.92 → P = 18358.60/0.92 = 19,955. Breaking the 9 years into 2+4+3 year slabs and summing their rate-contributions first avoids three separate SI calculations.
h: पहले दो वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज की दर 8% प्रति वर्ष है, अगले 4 वर्षों के लिए यह 10% प्रति वर्ष है और 6 वर्ष से अधिक की अवधि के लिए यह 12% प्रति वर्ष है। यदि किसी व्यक्ति को 9 वर्षों के बाद साधारण ब्याज के रूप में 18358.60 रुपये मिलते हैं। तो उसने कितना पैसा (रुपये में) निवेश किया?

t: Mukund deposits ₹57,000 in a bank at compound interest. The rate of interest is 10% p.a. for the first year and increases by 3% in the second year. What is the compound interest (in ₹) obtained in 2 years?
e:
Year 2 rate = 10%+3% = 13%. Combined growth factor = 1.10 × 1.13 = 1.243. Amount = 57000 × 1.243 = 70,851. CI = 70851-57000 = ₹13,851.

After year 1: 57000 × 1.10 = 62,700. After year 2 (rate 13%): 62700 × 1.13 = 70,851. CI = 70851 - 57000 = ₹13,851. Note: "increases by 3%" means the new rate is 10+3=13%, not a 3% increase on the rate itself — a common trap in this question type.
h: मुकुंद ने ₹57,000 बैंक में चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर जमा किए। पहले वर्ष ब्याज दर 10% वार्षिक है और दूसरे वर्ष में यह 3% बढ़ जाती है। 2 वर्षों में प्राप्त चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (₹ में) कितना होगा?

t: 4 chairs and 14 tables cost ₹4,000 and 16 chairs and 12 tables cost ₹5,000. What is the cost of 8 chairs and 4 tables?
e:
4chair+14table=4000 ...(i); 16chair+12table=5000 ...(ii) (i)×4: 16chair+56table=16000; subtract (ii): 44table=11000 → table=250. From (i): 4chair=4000-3500=500 → chair=125. 8(125)+4(250) = 1000+1000 = 2000.

Eliminate "chair" by matching coefficients (multiply (i) by 4 to match 16 in (ii)), solve table=250, then chair=125 from back substitution. 8(125)+4(250)=₹2,000.
h: 4 कुर्सियों और 14 मेजों की कीमत ₹4,000 है और 16 कुर्सियों और 12 मेजों की कीमत ₹5,000 है। 8 कुर्सियों और 4 मेजों की कीमत क्या है?

t: A bookstore sells 2 mathematics books and 3 science books for ₹1,980. It also sells 3 mathematics books and 2 science books for ₹1,920. What is the total cost of one mathematics book and one science book?
e:
Simply add both given equations directly: (2M+3S)+(3M+2S) = 1980+1920 ⟹ 5M+5S = 3900 ⟹ M+S = 3900/5 = 780, matching option (a) without solving for M and S individually.

Let M=maths book, S=science book. 2M+3S=1980 ... (i); 3M+2S=1920 ... (ii). Adding (i)+(ii): 5M+5S=3900 ⟹ M+S=780. (Individually: solving gives M=360, S=420, and indeed 360+420=780.)
h: एक बुकस्टोर 2 गणित की किताबें और 3 विज्ञान की किताबें ₹1,980 में बेचता है। वह साथ ही 3 गणित की किताबें और 2 विज्ञान की किताबें ₹1,920 में बेचता है। एक गणित की किताब और एक विज्ञान की किताब का कुल मूल्य कितना है?

t: Evaluate 23³ + (– 11)³ + (– 12)³
e:
Since 23 + (–11) + (–12) = 0, the identity a³+b³+c³ = 3abc applies directly: 3×23×(−11)×(−12) = 3×23×132 = 9108. Digit-sum cross-check: DS(23)=5, DS(11)=2, DS(12)=3; 3×5×2×3=90→9; DS(9108)=18→9. This matches, confirming (c).

Because 23 + (–11) + (–12) = 0, we use the identity a³+b³+c³ = 3abc. So the value = 3×23×(–11)×(–12) = 3×23×132 = 9108.

t: In a group of 40 boys, the average height was initially determined to be 160 cm. However, it was later discovered that the height of one boy was incorrectly recorded as 165 cm when it should have been 156 cm. Calculate the accurate average height.
e:
Error in total = 165-156 = 9 cm too much was added. Corrected total = 40×160 - 9 = 6400-9 = 6391. Corrected average = 6391/40 = 159.775 cm.

Wrong total = 40×160 = 6400. Since 165 was recorded instead of the correct 156, the total was inflated by (165-156)=9. Correct total = 6400-9 = 6391. Correct average = 6391/40 = 159.775 cm.
h: 40 लड़कों के एक समूह में, औसत ऊंचाई शुरू में 160 सेमी निर्धारित की गई थी। हालांकि, बाद में पता चला कि एक लड़के की ऊंचाई गलत तरीके से 165 सेमी दर्ज की गई थी, जबकि यह 156 सेमी होनी चाहिए थी। सटीक औसत ऊंचाई की गणना करें।

t: The price of fuel decreases by 40%, 60%, and 60% over three consecutive months, but increases by 70% in the fourth month. In the fourth month, what is the percentage increase or decrease in fuel prices compared to the original price?
e:
Multiply the retained fractions: 0.60×0.40×0.40×1.70. This is a small fraction (about 0.163) of the original, meaning roughly an 84% decrease overall, closely matching option (d) 83.68% decrease.

Net factor = 0.60×0.40×0.40×1.70 = 0.1632. So new price = 16.32% of original, a decrease of 100−16.32 = 83.68%.
h: ईंधन की कीमत लगातार तीन महीनों में 40%, 60% और 60% घटती है, लेकिन चौथे महीने में 70% बढ़ जाती है। चौथे महीने में ईंधन की कीमतों में इसकी मूल कीमत की तुलना में कितना प्रतिशत वृद्धि या कमी हुई है?

t: The price of each article of type P, Q, and R is 280, 180 and 115, respectively. Rohit buys articles of each type in the ratio 4:2:7 for ₹6,855. How many articles of type Q did he purchase?
e:
Let quantities be 4k, 2k, 7k. Total cost = 280(4k)+180(2k)+115(7k) = 1120k+360k+805k = 2285k. 2285k = 6855 → k = 3. Quantity of Q = 2k = 6.

Cost per "unit set" (1 of each ratio part) = 280(4)+180(2)+115(7) = 1120+360+805 = 2285. Number of such sets, k = 6855/2285 = 3. Type Q quantity = 2×3 = 6 articles.
h: P, Q और R प्रकार की प्रत्येक वस्तु की कीमत क्रमशः ₹280, ₹180 और ₹115 है। रोहित प्रत्येक प्रकार की वस्तुएँ 4:2:7 के अनुपात में ₹6,855 में खरीदता है। उसने Q प्रकार की कितनी वस्तुएँ खरीदीं?

t: P = 99, then P(P² + 3P + 3) = ?
e:
P³+3P²+3P is one term short of the expansion of (P+1)³ = P³+3P²+3P+1. So P³+3P²+3P = (P+1)³ − 1. With P+1 = 100, we get 100³ − 1 = 999999, matching option (d) instantly without long multiplication.

P(P²+3P+3) = P³+3P²+3P = (P³+3P²+3P+1) − 1 = (P+1)³ − 1. Putting P=99: (100)³ − 1 = 1000000 − 1 = 999999.

t: Group A has 48 members, Group B has 46 members, and Group C has 36 members. The average amount spent per member in Groups A, B, and C is ₹477, ₹236, and ₹348, respectively. Find the overall average amount spent per member (in ₹).
e:
Weighted average = (48×477+46×236+36×348)/(48+46+36). Rough estimate: total spend ≈22896+10856+12528=46280, total members=130, average≈356, matching option (c).

Total spent = 48×477+46×236+36×348 = 22896+10856+12528 = 46280. Total members = 48+46+36 = 130. Average = 46280/130 = 356.
h: समूह A में 48 सदस्य, समूह B में 46 सदस्य और समूह C में 36 सदस्य हैं। इन सभी समूहों के सदस्य एक रेस्टोरेंट में गए। समूह A, B और C के प्रत्येक सदस्य पर व्यय की गई औसत धनराशि क्रमशः ₹477, ₹236 और ₹348 है। प्रति सदस्य व्यय की गई समग्र औसत धनराशि (₹ में) ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A grocer's sales for five consecutive months were Rs. 5456, Rs. 5972, Rs. 5857, Rs. 5235, and Rs. 5526. What must his sales be in the sixth month to achieve an average sale of Rs. 6400?
e:
Total needed for 6 months at average 6400 = 38400. Sum of first five months ≈ 28046. Required sixth month sale ≈ 38400−28046 = 10354, matching option (d).

Required total = 6400×6 = 38400. Sum of 5 months = 5456+5972+5857+5235+5526 = 28046. Sixth month sales = 38400−28046 = 10354.
h: एक किराना दुकानदार की लगातार पाँच महीनों की बिक्री क्रमशः 5456 रुपये, 5972 रुपये, 5857 रुपये, 5235 रुपये और 5526 रुपये थी। 6400 रुपये की औसत बिक्री हासिल करने के लिए छठे महीने में उसकी बिक्री कितनी होनी चाहिए?

t: A person sets up a concession stand and sells burgers and soft drinks. Each burger costs ₹15, and each soft drink costs ₹5. By the end, having sold a total of 87 burgers and soft drinks, he earns a total income of ₹785. How many soft drinks were sold in total?
e:
If all 87 were burgers, income would be 87×15=1305, which is 520 more than 785. Each soft drink instead of a burger reduces income by 10, so 520/10=52 soft drinks — matching option (a).

Let soft drinks = s, burgers = 87−s. 15(87−s)+5s = 785 ⟹ 1305−10s = 785 ⟹ 10s = 520 ⟹ s = 52.
h: एक व्यक्ति बास्केटबॉल मैच के दौरान एक रियायती स्टॉल लगाता है और बर्गर एवं सॉफ्ट ड्रिंक्स बेचता है। प्रत्येक बर्गर की कीमत ₹15 और सॉफ्ट ड्रिंक की कीमत ₹5 है। अंत में, कुल 87 बर्गर और सॉफ्ट ड्रिंक बेचकर उसे कुल ₹785 की आय अर्जित होती है। कुल कितनी सॉफ्ट ड्रिंक बेची गई?

t: A city's population grows by 10% in the first year, 20% in the second year and 10% in the third year. If the population after 3 years is 8,71,200, then what was the original population 3 years ago?
h: एक शहर की जनसंख्या पहले वर्ष में 10%, दूसरे वर्ष में 20% और तीसरे वर्ष में 10% बढ़ती है। यदि 3 वर्ष बाद जनसंख्या 8,71,200 हो जाती है, तो 3 वर्ष पहले मूल जनसंख्या कितनी थी?

h: मि. राम साधारण ब्याज प्राप्त करने के लिए 4 वर्षों के लिए 2% प्रति वर्ष की दर से 12200 रुपये की राशि का निवेश करते हैं। बाद में वह मूल राशि के साथ-साथ साधारण ब्याज के रूप में प्राप्त राशि को अगले 4 वर्षों के लिए उसी ब्याज दर पर निवेश करता है। पिछले 4 वर्षों के अंत में उसे कितनी राशि का साधारण ब्याज मिलेगा?

t: The monthly average salary for 8 employees plus one supervisor is ₹15,000. If the supervisor earns ₹25,000, what is the average salary of the 8 employees?
e:
Total of all 9 people = 9×15000 = 135000. Total of 8 employees = 135000-25000 = 110000. Average of 8 employees = 110000/8 = 13,750.

Sum for 9 people = 135000. Subtract supervisor's salary (25000) to get employees' total = 110000. Divide by 8 → ₹13,750 average.
h: 8 कर्मचारियों और एक सुपरवाइजर का मासिक औसत वेतन ₹15,000 है। यदि सुपरवाइजर ₹25,000 कमाता है, तो 8 कर्मचारियों का औसत वेतन क्या है?

e:
Retained fraction = 0.75×0.74 = 0.555. Digit-sum check: DS(21600)=2+1+6=9, DS(0.555-part→555)=15→6, product-DS=9×6=54→9. Only option (a) 11988 has DS=1+1+9+8+8=27→9, matching exactly and confirming it directly.

h: एक व्यापारी क्रमशः 25% और 26% की दो क्रमिक छूट के बाद वस्तु बेचता है। यदि वस्तु का अंकित मूल्य ₹21,600 है, तो विक्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए?

t: The marked price of a water bottle is ₹950. A man bought the same for ₹740, after getting two successive discounts. If the first discount is 12%, then what is the second discount?
e:
After 12% off, price = 950×0.88 = 836. The second discount reduces 836 to 740, a drop of about 96, which is roughly 11.5% of 836 — matching option (d).

After first discount: 950×0.88 = 836. Second discount % = (836−740)/836×100 = 96/836×100 ≈ 11.48%.
h: एक पानी की बोतल का अंकित मूल्य 950 रुपये है। एक व्यक्ति ने लगातार दो छूट प्राप्त करने के बाद इसे 740 रुपये में खरीदा। यदि पहली छूट 12% है, तो दूसरी छूट क्या है?

t: The cost of 3 cups and 4 glasses is ₹270. If 2 more glasses are purchased, the total amount becomes ₹330. Find the cost of one cup.
e:
2 extra glasses cost ₹60, so one glass = ₹30. Substituting back: 3 cups + 4(30) = 270 ⟹ 3 cups = 150 ⟹ 1 cup = 50, matching option (d).

2 glasses cost 330−270=60, so 1 glass = 30. From 3 cups+4 glasses=270: 3 cups = 270−120 = 150, so 1 cup = 50.
h: 3 कप और 4 गिलासों की कीमत ₹270 है। यदि 2 गिलास और खरीदे जाएँ, तो कुल राशि ₹330 हो जाती है। एक कप की कीमत ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The average age of 40 students in a class is 16 years. When a new student is admitted, the average increases by 0.2 years. What is the age of the new student?
e:
New average = 16.2, new count = 41. New student's age = New total - Old total = 41×16.2 - 40×16 = 664.2-640 = 24.2.

Original total = 40×16 = 640. New total (41 students, avg 16.2) = 41×16.2 = 664.2. New student's age = 664.2-640 = 24.2 years.
h: एक कक्षा में 40 छात्रों की औसत आयु 16 वर्ष है। जब एक नया छात्र प्रवेश लेता है, तो औसत 0.2 वर्ष बढ़ जाता है। नए छात्र की आयु क्या है?

t: If the digits of a two-digit number are interchanged, the value of the number decreases by 18. The digit at the tens place is double the digit at unit place. What is the number?
e:
Let the two-digit number be 10x + y.
Numbers obtained by interchanging the digits = 10y + x
∴ (10x + y) - (10y + x) = 18
=> 9x - 9y = 18
=> x - y = 2 ..(i)
Also, y = x/2
=> 2y = x ..(ii)
From (i) and (ii), y = 2 and x = 4.
∴ The number is 42.
h: यदि दो अंकों वाली संख्या के अंकों को आपस में बदल दिया जाए, तो संख्या का मान 18 कम हो जाता है। दहाई के स्थान का अंक इकाई के स्थान के अंक का दोगुना है। संख्या क्या है?

t: How much will Rs 10,000 amount to in one year's time at 4% rate of interest per annum if the interest is compounded once every three months?
e:
Quarterly compounding at 1% per quarter for 4 quarters gives roughly 4% growth plus a small compounding bonus, landing just above 10,400 — matching option (a).

Rate per quarter = 4%/4 = 1%. Amount = 10000×(1.01)⁴ = 10000×1.040604 ≈ 10406.
h: यदि ब्याज हर तीन महीने में एक बार संयोजित किया जाता है, तो 4% वार्षिक ब्याज दर पर एक वर्ष में 10000 रुपये कितने हो जाएँगे?

t: A retailer marks an article 30% above its cost price. During a clearance sale, he gives two successive discounts of 15% and 10% on the marked price. If the final selling price is Rs 11934, find the cost price of the article.

Overall multiplying factor from CP to SP = 1.30×0.85×0.90 ≈ 0.9945, so CP ≈ SP/0.9945 ≈ 12000, matching option (a) neatly (a round number, a good sign in MCQ problems).

h: एक खुदरा विक्रेता एक वस्तु पर उसके क्रय मूल्य से 30% अधिक मूल्य अंकित करता है। एक क्लीयरेंस सेल के दौरान, वह अंकित मूल्य पर 15% और 10% की दो क्रमिक छूट देता है। यदि अंतिम विक्रय मूल्य 11934 रुपये है, तो वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The sum of three digits of a number is 18. The digit in hundreds place is twice the digit in tens place and the digit in tens place is 2/3 <sup>rd</sup> of the digit in ones place. Find the product of the digits of the number.
e:
Let, the digit in ones place = m
Digit in tens place = 2m/3
Digit in hundreds place = 2 * 2m/3 = 4m/3
m + 2m/3 + 4m/3 = 18
=> 9m/3 = 18
=> m = 6
Hence, the number = 846
Product of the digits of the number = 8*4*6 = 192

e:

t: A person invested ₹54,500 at 12% p.a. simple interest for 2 years. Find the amount (in ₹) received after 2 years.
e:

t: What is the number of trailing zero in 688!?
e:

Quotient of 688/5 = 137
Quotient of 137/5 = 27
Quotient of 27/5 = 5
Quotient of 5/5 = 1
Total number of zeroes = 137 + 27 + 5 + 1 = 170

t: The average of 9 numbers is 56. When one number is removed, the average becomes 54. What number was removed?
e:
Removed number = (Old total) - (New total) = 9×56 - 8×54 = 504-432 = 72.

Sum of 9 numbers = 9×56 = 504. Sum of remaining 8 numbers = 8×54 = 432. Removed number = 504-432 = 72.

t: Find the sum of unit digits of 456<sup>33</sup>, 425<sup>29</sup> and 448<sup>22</sup>.
e: The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number. Cyclicity chart:Number | Cyclicity | Unit digit values Power 1 | Power 2 | Power 3 | Power 4 0 | 1 | 0 | | | 1 | 1 | 1 | | | 2 | 4 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 6 3 | 4 | 3 | 9 | 7 | 1 4 | 2 | 4 | 6 | | 5 | 1 | 5 | | | 6 | 1 | 6 | | | 7 | 4 | 7 | 9 | 3 | 1 8 | 4 | 8 | 4 | 2 | 6 9 | 2 | 9 | 1 | | (Note: when remainder is 0, power = cyclicity) In 45633: Unit digit of 436 is 6. From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 6 is 1. So, we have to divide the power of 436 i.e.33 by 1. After dividing 33 by 1, remainder = 0. So, power = cyclicity = 1 Unit digit of 61 = 6 In 42529: Unit digit of 425 is 5. From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 5 is 1. So, we have to divide the power of 425 i.e. 29 by 1. After dividing 29 by 1, remainder = 0. So, power = cyclicity = 1 In this case, unit digit of 51 = 5 In 44822: Unit digit of 448 is 8. From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 8 is 4. So, we have to divide the power of 448 i.e. 22 by 4. After dividing 22 by 4, remainder = 2. So, power ≠ cyclicity In this case, unit digit of 82 = 4 Therefore, sum of unit digits of 45633, 42529 and 44822 = 15
h: (456<sup>33</sup> + 425<sup>29 </sup>+ 448<sup>22</sup>) के इकाई अंक का योग ज्ञात करें?
